facts.fact: 听完判决 Finlay 跳起来，掐着喉咙、喉结上下滚动，在屋里踱步要水。
facts.anchor: Hands clutching his throat, Adam’s apple visibly bobbing up and down, Finlay springs to his feet and begins to pace the length of the room.

facts.fact: 她慌到呛水，直觉教她把手腕伸进冰水——心跳才慢慢降回来。
facts.anchor: Plunging both my wrists under the icy water that’s still running, I hold them there, despite the sting.

facts.fact: 她自知谎言已炸碎道德，但不了解他的脾气深浅，决定硬着头皮演到底。
facts.anchor: I’ve just blown my morals to smithereens, but I don’t know how he’ll react when I tell him that I made it all up.

facts.fact: 回房时他已平静地坐着等她——仿佛刚才没人对他宣告他女友没了。
facts.anchor: Thankfully, the first thing I notice before even stepping a foot back in the room is that he’s sitting down again, patiently waiting for my return as if I’d just nipped to the loo and nothing more.

facts.fact: 他咬紧下颌，等着「期待已久的 closure」，目光钉在她不肯张开的嘴上。
facts.anchor: He clenches his jaw in preparation for long-awaited closure, staring at my mouth as my lips refuse to part.

facts.fact: 她正式宣判：你是对的——你女朋友不幸离世了。
facts.anchor: ‘I am very sorry for your loss. You were right, your girlfriend is unfortunately no longer with us.’

facts.fact: 话音落地，暴雨砸窗如砖、闪电惊雷。
facts.anchor: Rain begins to lash from the sky, pelting the glass like bricks. A flash of lightning, quickly followed by a crash of thunder, causes me to flinch

facts.fact: 暴风雨夜，房间里成了三个人：他肩后站着一个女人。
facts.anchor: Before the storm, there were just two people in this room – and now, including the woman standing behind his shoulder, there are three.
